evidence.reason: The structural test only checks that guarded names are AST descendants of a finish_cleanup call. It does not require them to be inside lambda/action bodies, so an eager `stop_process(...)` argument would pass even though Python evaluates it before `finish_cleanup`; if it raises, queue and run-metadata restoration can be skipped. The test comment explicitly says these operations may appear only inside `finish_cleanup(...)`, never in an inline sequence, so this is a gap in the intended check rather than a new requirement.
